description.value: 93 Coffee is a cozy Japanese-style cafe tucked inside the Denman Place Mall in Vancouver's West End neighbourhood. It offers breakfast, lunch, dinner, and a dedicated drink menu, positioning itself as an all-day stop. Its central West End location makes it a convenient refuelling point for cyclists exploring the nearby Seawall.
